Page 1509 
 
AND 
 
2 - ONE of the following:  
 
 2.1 History of a 30 day or longer trial and failure of one of the following:  
• 
metronidazole cream, gel, or lotion  
• 
azelaic acid gel  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 Contraindication or intolerance to both of the following:  
• 
metronidazole cream, gel, or lotion  
• 
azelaic acid gel
